audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagreed with the mirror and with their own whys text — level 1 was scored Skill while its why says the turret out-zones him, and the four Feast-stack rows were scored Heimerdinger or Skill while their whys say he out-scales the nest.
audit.why: Cho'Gath is dash-less with a 300-range silence cone, so Heimerdinger genuinely owns levels 1-2; once Feast stacks and an HP item land, the turret economy stops threatening his health bar. The mirror set Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the mirror on both layers with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase row was template text with no cooldown or range in it.
audit.why: Rupture is 6s at 950, Feral Scream 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s in a 300-range cone, Feast 80/70/60s at 175 range. Those three numbers are what decide when Heimerdinger may step forward.
audit.corrected: Real ranges and cooldowns written into phases 0-6 and the interactions line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was called 'CH-3X' with a 'center-stun' that 'roots', and the turret beam was repeatedly credited with a slow it does not have.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade — 11s flat, 970 range — and it stuns only the unit hit directly, slowing those around it; it never roots. Riot's turret text describes a pass-through beam with no slow. The slow in this lane is Vorpal Spikes, his E. Feral Scream's silence is the decisive interaction: silenced, Heimerdinger can neither grenade nor re-drop a turret, and that is the window Feast lands in.
audit.corrected: Land CH-2's direct hit as he steps up; never be inside the 300-range Feral Scream cone, because a silence costs you both the stun and the replant.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours because Cho is a slow, dash-less body and his Feast stacks do not exist yet — drop your first turret, then bank a second and let the electron beam's slow tax every step he takes toward CS. Do not facecheck his Rupture range to dive a turret-drop; lob your CH-3X grenade so the center-stun lands as he steps up to last-hit, and let the beams free-fire on a rooted target. His Q outranges your auto and pops you up, so respect it, but his W silence is a short cone — he cannot reach you across a full nest yet.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours because Cho is a slow, dash-less body and his Feast stacks do not exist yet — drop your first turret, then bank a second and let the pass-through beams tax every step he takes toward CS. Do not facecheck his Rupture range to dive a turret-drop; lob your CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade so the direct hit stuns him as he steps up to last-hit, and let the beams free-fire while he is locked. His Q reaches 950 and pops you up, so respect it, but Feral Scream is a 300-range cone — he cannot reach you across a full nest yet.

notes: The whys and spikes text already described the mirror's chart correctly — only the side and win fields were wrong, so this was a pure two-layer chart repair plus name fixes. Cho'Gath's kit flags Rupture as grounding; Riot's description says only knock-up, damage and slow, so no grounding claim was written.
